text:
Rae: Novus Compute reached out to run a joint perf/W + throughput validation next week. They want a reproducible runbook, per-GPU and node PDU readings, and a short joint methodology for a co-authored note.

Diego: Prefer we give them our container + harness so results are comparable. Need to agree on model (suggest opt-3B), seq lengths, and publishable configs.

Novus CI Bot: Available slots Tue/Wed 03:00-06:00 UTC. Upload target s3://redwood-partner-novus/2001234567/. Accepts docker tag label redwood/bench:partner.

Lena: Legal: we can only publish aggregated numbers and synthetic-model runs. No serials or build IDs. I'll draft the short publication consent to share with Novus.

Diego: Kernel sweep knobs: threadblock 32/64, tile_mode compact/striped, async_copy on/off. Two publishable configs: "throughput-max" (batch=16, seq=512) and "efficiency" (batch=1, seq=1024, q4_nop).

Ops Bot: Telemetry to collect: per_gpu_power(W), node_power(W), tokens_per_sec, p95_latency(ms), gpu_util(%), ambient_temp(C). Warmup 30s, measure 90s, reps=3.

Cam: Runbook snippet for container README:
```
export REDWOOD_UPLOAD=s3://redwood-partner-novus/2001234567/$RUN
docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_TELEMETRY=partner-s3 -v $(pwd)/out:/out redwood/bench:partner \
  --model opt-3B --batch $BATCH --seq $SEQ --warmup 30 --reps 3 --sweep sweep.csv --upload $REDWOOD_UPLOAD
```
Rae: Marketing wants two headline drafts and a 48h embargo after validation. Also request Novus logo and brand guidelines.

Diego: Action items: (1) I will build the docker + sweep.csv (due Mon EOD). (2) Lena will send legal draft to Novus (due Mon EOD). (3) Cam will prepare dashboard template for Console: tokens/s vs perf/W scatter + p95 heatmap (due Mon EOD). Novus CI Bot: please reserve Tue 03:30 slot.

Novus CI Bot: Slot reserved Tue 03:30 UTC on novus-ci-5. Notification to this thread on completion.

Cam: When logs are uploaded, tag them with run_id and include summary.csv with node-averaged numbers only. We'll redact any raw serials.

Lena: Got it. I'll ask Novus to sign off on the publishable CSV scope before we release anything.

Rae: Thanks all. If no blockers we'll proceed with the plan and sync after the run.
